purpose: Test only whether a causally known, material pure-cash distribution can form a sufficiently broad and semantically valid pre-2021 mother population. Stage A may count identities and inspect contemporaneous representation geometry, but it may not attach any forward price, trade, payoff, target, exit, chart outcome or portfolio field.
economic_hypothesis: A large cash distribution is an issuer action that has actually transferred cash to shareholders. After the mechanical ex-date adjustment, a high gross cash yield may identify realized payout quality and valuation support without substituting a restated accounting statement. The frozen natural direction is long higher realized cash yield, but Stage A cannot establish Alpha or even read a future return.
scientific_claim_boundary: PIT-B bounded research feasibility only. QD-010 is a frozen current historical snapshot without a complete historical revision-vintage chain; this experiment cannot make a strict archival PIT, production, live-trading or fundamental-quality claim.

novelty_boundary.not_material_supply_expansion: V34 requires share_multiplier exactly one and tests an issuer cash transfer; the prior supply-expansion mother explicitly excluded same-day corporate-action coordinate events and tested a change in circulating shares.
novelty_boundary.not_price_or_volume: No return, momentum, MAX, volatility, gap, support, breakout, VWAP, candle, turnover or volume field defines the mother event.
novelty_boundary.not_fundamental_statement_proxy: No income statement, balance sheet, cash-flow statement, book value, earnings or restated PIT fundamental field is read. The representation is the announced and effective cash actually distributed per pre-ex-date market price.
novelty_boundary.not_v30_v31_v32_v33: V30 is price-turnover positive feedback, V31 is a stock-minus-industry return-serial transition, V32 is turnover-innovation decoupling, and V33 is risk-warning removal. V34 uses none of those identities or states.
novelty_boundary.no_prior_strategy_repair: No existing strategy, champion, candidate list, trade or outcome is an input.

registry.identity_policy: Validate exact QD-010/CY-006 semantics, hash the registry at runner start, and require the identical hash immediately before publication.

corporate_action_id_contract.v34_strictness: The overall string wire may first receive the canonical whole-string strip. Before calling the hash-bound repository parse_action_ids function directly, V34 rejects every null/NaN, empty, padded or duplicate member using its original canonical str(item) value. The QD-010 event_id must itself be a nonempty string equal to its stripped value, and the canonical parsed event-day tuple must equal that original QD-010 event_id exactly.

cy045_joint_authorization_envelope.joint_binding: Before any source parquet is statted, hashed or opened, the runner must validate the registry CY-045 asset, the exact bounded authorization and this immutable manifest as a three-way binding to the current spec SHA-256, current runner SHA-256 and every frozen input path/SHA-256.
cy045_joint_authorization_envelope.pre_authorization_access: Only the V34 spec, repository registry, CY-045 manifest and current runner may be statted, hashed or parsed. No QD-010/CY-006 source or inventory may be touched.
cy045_joint_authorization_envelope.inventory_metadata_only: QD-010 and CY-006 inventory JSON may be parsed only to verify frozen root/path/SHA-256 metadata. Inventory contents may not authorize extra files, dates, rows, outcomes or fields.
cy045_joint_authorization_envelope.whole_artifact_hash_boundary: After joint authorization only, each exact bound source artifact may be read byte-for-byte solely to verify its complete SHA-256 before any permitted Stage-A row parse. A matching whole-file hash does not authorize rows after 2020, future paths, outcomes, charts or a portfolio.
cy045_joint_authorization_envelope.forbidden_even_after_authorization: Every post-signal row, outcome attachment, outcome artifact, chart, Stage B, portfolio, 2021-plus row, parameter search and current-survivor fallback remains false.

frozen_mother_signal.universe: Historical Main Board and ChiNext identities only: 600/601/603/605.SH and 000/001/002/300/301.SZ. The CY-006 event-date row must be non-ST, hard-valid, currently tradable, trade_status=1, PIT-industry-valid, nonblocking and available by its completed close. Industry and every required snapshot ID must be non-null and non-blank after whitespace stripping.
frozen_mother_signal.pure_cash_action: Exactly one QD-010 distribution row may exist for symbol/effective_date. It must have cash_per_share_gross>0, share_multiplier exactly 1, rights_subscription_ratio exactly 0, source_terms_complete=true, finite known_at and effective_date, no changed/previous revision marker, revision_ordinal=1, and no QD-010 rights row for the same symbol/effective_date. The parsed CY-006 corporate_action_ids must contain exactly the same sole QD-010 event_id and corporate_action_count must equal one. Missing, malformed, duplicate or conflicting terms/identities fail closed.
frozen_mother_signal.availability: The original QD-010 known_at must be no later than the CY-006 event-date decision_at. effective_date must equal the CY-006 trade_date. No announcement-time inference other than the accepted QD-010 conservative known_at semantics is allowed.
frozen_mother_signal.representation: cash_yield = cash_per_share_gross / raw CY-006 preclose on effective date t. Both terms must be finite and strictly positive.
frozen_mother_signal.materiality: cash_yield >= 0.02 exactly. This one 2 percent gross distribution-yield threshold is frozen once as an economically material realized payout; no neighboring threshold is authorized.
frozen_mother_signal.decision_at: Completed effective-date session t close. The event is not allowed to fill in session t; the earliest hypothetical fill is a later legal open, which Stage A does not inspect or evaluate.
frozen_mother_signal.cooldown: Process qualifying events in signal-date/event-id order per symbol. Retain an event only when its global signal calendar index is strictly more than 120 sessions after the last retained event for that symbol.

allowed: validate the frozen CY-045 registry/authorization/manifest envelope before touching any source or inventory
verify frozen file hashes and QD-010/CY-006 registry semantics
parse CY-006 corporate_action_ids under the frozen repository encoding contract and require exact one-ID equality to the QD-010 event_id
audit relevant 2018-2020 QD-010 duplicates, row revisions, completeness, known_at and effective-date ordering
join only the event-date CY-006 row and market-calendar index
calculate cash_yield and the frozen 120-session cooldown
write an outcome-free eligible representation panel and retained candidate identity table
report exact annual retained candidates, unique symbols, decision dates, PIT industries and cash-yield distribution
report non-filtering contemporaneous Spearman collision diagnostics against raw preclose, circulating market value, turnover fraction and cash per share
forbidden: any stock price, return, volume, state, entry, target, exit or outcome after signal session t
any future return, payoff, MFE, MAE, hit label, outcome bucket, chart path or portfolio artifact
any 2021 or later source partition or corporate-action row
any existing strategy candidate, trade or outcome artifact
parameter grids, threshold rescue, sign rescue or added candidate filters
stage_a_protocol.semantic_gate: Every duplicate, time-order, row-revision, action-conflict, source-term, source-hash, corporate-action identity, nonblank PIT industry, nonblank required snapshot ID and event-date CY-006 validity audit must pass exactly. Unknown required lineage fails closed and forbids canonical Stage-A publication.
stage_a_protocol.opportunity_gate_failure_policy: If and only if every semantic/PIT/input gate passes, failure of the annual >50-candidate or >=20-industry opportunity gate may publish the canonical Stage-A count/candidate audit with status FAILED_OPPORTUNITY_GATE_PERMANENTLY_CLOSED. That artifact permanently forbids V34 Stage B, charts, forward outcomes and definition rescue.

output_contract.write_policy: Create through a sibling staging directory. At startup and again immediately before publication, independently revalidate the complete CY-045 registry/authorization/manifest envelope, then re-hash every frozen input including spec, registry, manifest and runner; require the two complete hash maps to be identical, re-check that canonical stage_a does not exist, and atomically rename without overwrite. Any semantic/PIT/input failure removes staging and publishes nothing. An opportunity-gate failure may publish only an explicit FAILED_OPPORTUNITY_GATE_PERMANENTLY_CLOSED Stage-A audit/candidate corpus and can never authorize Stage B or charts.

next_action: Run Stage A only after an independent audit of this freeze and its bound runner. If every semantic and opportunity gate passes, a separate outcome contract would still be required. If only the opportunity gate fails, freeze the explicit FAILED Stage-A audit and permanently close V34. This freeze never authorizes Stage B, charts, portfolio replay or later-period access.
